articles.summary: Covista, America's Largest Healthcare Educator, Opening First Tennessee Location to Help Address the State's Widening Nursing Shortage New Campus Will Be Chamberlain's 27th Location Nationwide Chamberlain University, America's largest school of nursing and a Covista (NYSE: CVSA) institution, today announced it will open a new campus in Nashville, Tennessee, its first location in the state. The campus continues Chamberlain's national expansion strategy to address the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage and will offer day, evening and weekend class options, giving students more flexible opportunities to pursue a nursing degree. The university will begin accepting applications on September 9, 2026, with pre-licensure Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) classes beginning January 4, 2027. The new campus is a direct response to Tennessee's widening healthcare workforce gap.
